keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the two excavated centres of the central and south-western Anatolian Neolithic as radii. Catalhoyuk "existed from around 7500 BC to 5600 BC and flourished around 7000 BC"; its West Mound "was occupied in the Early Chalcolithic period, beginning around 5600 BC"; Hacilar level VI dates "5600 BC", level II "c. 5300 BC", level I "after 5000 BC". No area figure to compare; the wider Neolithic of the Lake District and Cilicia is not on the pages.

ledger.note: 6000 BCE: the great Neolithic town of Catalhoyuk and the village of Hacilar hold the Anatolian plateau. Catalhoyuk infobox "Built: c. 7100 BC"; "Initial estimates suggested an average population of between 5,000 and 7,000", recent work "between 600 and 800 people" in the Middle phase (6700-6500 BC); Hacilar "dated back 7040 BC at its earliest stage" (its page). Both began long before the project's first year of 6000 BCE.

5600 BCE: the Early Chalcolithic begins; Catalhoyuk East is abandoned and the West Mound settled. Infobox "Abandoned: c. 5600 BC"; the West Mound "was occupied in the Early Chalcolithic period, beginning around 5600 BC"; Hacilar level VI "dating back to 5600 BC" (its page), level II fortified "c. 5300 BC".

region.text: the Konya Plain and the Burdur basin: Catalhoyuk "overlooks the Konya Plain, southeast of the present-day city of Konya" (East Mound "about 12.5 hectares"), Hacilar "23 km south of present-day Burdur"

ledger.note: 5000 BCE: the Anatolian Neolithic sequence on the map ends with Hacilar I. Hacilar level I dates "after 5000 BC" with a character "that suggests newcomers"; the site was "abandoned and reoccupied on more than one occasion"; the Catalhoyuk page gives no end for the West Mound. The end year bridges a silence.

certainty.note: Two radii around excavated sites stand for a culture whose extent the pages do not describe.

notes: Culture dossier for the Anatolian Neolithic/Early Chalcolithic between the project floor and c. 5000 BCE, built from the two type sites only; Can Hasan, Kurucay, Hoyucek, Mersin-Yumuktepe and the Lake District are not on the pages and the shape is two radii. The first fetch of "Hacılar" (dotless i) returned the Kayseri district page; the ASCII title "Hacilar" is the archaeological site. Gazetteer: Catalhoyuk and Hacilar are not places; Konya and Burdur stand in; "Konya Plain" and "Lake District" are not regions.
